description: Creates or updates web crawlers, matched by ItemId, then by DisplayText within the same crawl strategy. The strategy must be registered on the site.

items.description: A web crawler: the crawl strategy, the Web AI data source it feeds and the strategy's settings in Properties.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Source.description: The name of the crawl strategy, such as 'Sitemap'.

AIDataSourceId.description: The id of the Web AI data source the pages are indexed into. Import the data sources first.

ReindexIntervalMinutes.description: How often the site is crawled again, in minutes.

Properties.description: The strategy's settings, such as the sitemap URL.

Crawlers.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
